texto_aprovado: You've probably heard the question. Why does Australia have so many dangerous animals? People ask it about the snakes, the spiders, the jellyfish, the crocodiles and the sharks, usually all in one breath. Before the why, though, it helps to settle how dangerous those animals actually are.
